vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: The extra services a hotel offers its guests
The counter where the staff receive guests
Included in the price, at no extra cost
The team that cleans and prepares the rooms
A room booked in advance under your name
Permission to leave the room later than usual
Money left as a guarantee and given back later
A room that is free and available

vocab.text: Careful with the pair: complimentary means free of charge; complementary (with an e) means it completes something else. Hotels use the first one.

reading.rtitle: What the Front Desk Never Tells You
paras: Every hotel runs on the same short list of promises, and most guests never read it. There is a card on the desk, and there are two or three lines on the website, and that is where the real rules live. A reservation guarantees a room, not a specific room. A deposit is not a payment: it is money the hotel holds as a guarantee and gives back when you leave.

The word complimentary is the one worth learning. If breakfast is complimentary, it costs nothing. If the amenities are complimentary, the gym, the pool and the water in the room are already in the price. Late check-out, on the other hand, is almost never automatic. There is usually a rule, and there are usually exceptions, but you only get one if you ask. That is why the most useful sentence in any hotel starts with two words: Could I?

reading.prompt: What is the best title for this text?
choices: Why hotels are more expensive than they look
The rules behind the front desk, and how to ask for what you want

items: A reservation guarantees you one specific room.
The text says a reservation guarantees a room, not a specific room.
A deposit is money the hotel gives back when you leave.
The text says a deposit is money the hotel holds as a guarantee and gives back.
The text says it is almost never automatic and you only get one if you ask.
You arrive at midnight and your reservation is not in the system. Explain the situation and ask what the options are.
You want to know what is included in the price before you pay: breakfast, gym, water in the room.
Your flight leaves at nine in the evening and check-out is at eleven in the morning. Ask for what you need.

practice.title: Turn each cue into a full sentence. Use the structure in brackets.
items: Leave my bags here until six.

items.situation: You get to the room and there is no towel and no water. You call the front desk.
tips: Say what is missing with there is / there is not.
Ask politely: "Could you send someone up, please?"

items.situation: You need to know whether breakfast is included before you decide to eat at the hotel.
tips: Ask with Is there / Are there.
Use the word complimentary in your question.

items.situation: Your room is next to the lift and you cannot sleep.
tips: Describe the problem, then make the request.
"Could I change rooms?" is stronger than "I want another room."

items.situation: You want to leave your suitcase at the hotel after check-out and come back at six.
tips: Ask about the service first, then make the request.
"Is there somewhere I could leave my bags?"

items.situation: The receptionist asks for a deposit and you do not understand why.
tips: Ask what the money is for, politely.
"Could you explain what the deposit covers?"

answerkey.title: Reveal the model answers
list: There is a safe in the room.
There are two beds in the room.
Is there a gym in the hotel?
Could I leave my bags here until six?
answerkey.note: These are models, not the only correct answers. Any natural sentence with the right structure works.

listenings.text: Hello, this is Karen from the front desk with a message about your reservation. Your room is ready and check-in is from three in the afternoon. There is a deposit of one hundred dollars on arrival, and we give it back when you leave. Breakfast is complimentary and it is served until ten thirty. If you need a late check-out, please call us the night before. Thank you.

Welcome to the Riverside Hotel. Here is a short guide to the building. There is a gym on the second floor and it is open twenty-four hours. There are two lifts in the main hall and a business room next to the front desk. Housekeeping works from eight in the morning until four in the afternoon. All amenities on the second floor are complimentary for guests. We hope you enjoy your stay.

extra_audio.text: First, Thiago gives his name at the front desk. Then the receptionist finds the reservation. After that, she asks for a deposit and explains what it covers. Next, Thiago asks what is complimentary and whether there is a gym. Finally, he requests a late check-out and she confirms it.
